name: Y. D. Barzani Ltd.
summary: Y. D. Barzani Ltd. provides construction services. The company engages in the construction of apartments and other residential projects; urban renewal projects; and construction of roads and transportation, water, drainage, and urban development projects. It also plans, builds, and manages yielding real estate properties, including commercial centres and urban complexes featuring office, retail, and industrial spaces. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Mevaseret Zion, Israel.
